conclusions.subject: design
conclusions.text: root.yaml's Math_reshape, Work_schedule, Tile_pipeline and REALIZATION are complete local definitions of the P2-selected instance and are faithful to the fixed source in every relation I checked. Math: sig_fast/silu_fast reproduce fmaf(0.5, tanh.approx.f32(0.5x), 0.5) and are applied to the conv SiLU, both gate branches and beta while exp/log1p/rsqrt stay on the accurate path; conv accumulation is left-to-right over the four taps with the pre-call word (not the convolved value) appended to column 2+j and columns 0,1 copied from off_i+1/off_i+2; invq/invk/qdot are per-(t,g) scalars with k_hat materialized and q_hat never formed per element; raw = decay*invq*qsum + delta*qdot is algebraically the Contract readout of gdn_state(s+1) with q_hat=invq*q and k_hat=invk*k substituted; the advance is the source's fma32(delta, k_hat, gdn_state(s)*decay); rv = rsqrt(sum_gp sq_part/1024 + norm_eps) equals rsqrt(sum_r raw^2/head_dim + norm_eps) precisely because sq_part carries each row's square 8 times. Ledger gains and costs are all checkable against the formulas (window reads 4*len_i -> len_i+3, state passes 4 -> 2, retained len_i*head_dim readouts plus len_i*head_dim/16 partials and one extra barrier). Work: CONV is (request, 512-channel block) with ceil_div(channels,512)*request_count CTAs and GDN is (request, value head) with value_head_count*request_count CTAs, matching the dim3((channels/2+255)/256, n) and dim3(hv, n) grids of 256 threads; the steps stay a local iteration so the sequential state axis is inside one work; two Launch entries with start_after CONV.launch_ready and a single Handoff of m with wait_at GDN.mixed_ready reproduce the two submissions and the PDL join. Pipeline: one synchronous MAIN role per submission, storage account exactly equal to the source (23488 B smem across the 13 arrays consolidated into 9 regions, 32768 B state_preload and 65536 B carried_state in registers), q/k staged in the padded 160-wide permutation, all eight depth-8 regions justified by len_i <= spec_width <= 8. REALIZATION passes the deletion test on all five items and re-decides nothing upstream. The only defects I found are non-semantic and are recorded in the handoff rather than as issues.

conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: Traced fixed case 1 end to end: tp=1, head_ratio=2, width=8, 32 requests each of length 8 (total_tokens=256), h=16, hv=32, channels=8192, state_slot_padding=65536, conv_slot_padding=4096, accepted_mode=last. Host: h=(8192-32*128)/256=16, ratio=2; state strides 589824/16384/128 are all divisible by 16 on a 32-byte aligned base so vec=3; channels, css=86016, csp=8192 and ms0=12288 are even with 4-byte aligned conv_state/mixed and a 16-byte aligned conv_weight so conv_vec holds; ms0 and gs0 are divisible by 4 and out strides 4096/128 are even; fk_conv_total=16*32=512>160 so fk_flags is null and the two-launch branch runs — every clause of root's `when` is satisfied and the fused design is correctly excluded. Submission 1 is 512 CTAs (16 channel blocks x 32 requests) and submission 2 is 1024 CTAs (32 heads x 32 requests), matching both Worker_count fields. A CONV CTA grants launch permission at entry, then for conv_active[i] bursts the 8 pre-call 4-byte mixed words per channel pair, reads history columns 7,8,9 plus the uint4 of taps, copies columns 8,9 into columns 0,1, and for j=0..7 accumulates left to right, applies silu_fast, writes the packed BF16 pair over mixed and appends the pre-call word to column 2+j, so all ten history columns of the slot become exactly the Contract's conv_state_updated view. A GDN CTA (j,i) reads geometry, preloads four 256-bit row tiles of state[state_indices[i,7],j] into 32 registers per thread, waits on the grid dependency, has warp s reduce step s into invq/invk/qdot while staging raw q and k_hat, stages v, gate (sigmoid branch, since the fixed inputs pass output_gate_activation='sigmoid'), norm_weight, decay, beta and dst, crosses the single barrier, widens the preload into S[4][16], then for s=0..7 accumulates pred and qsum in one pass over 16 columns x 4 rows, reduces across the 8 column-block lanes in 3 levels, forms delta and raw, publishes raw and sq_part, advances the state and checkpoints all eight positive slots; the closing barrier is followed by the tail writing 8*128 out elements as 4-byte pairs with rv from the 8 group partials. Every Contract output has a determined producer: result from the active tail or the inactive zero path (and no row at all when len_i=0), mixed_qkv_updated and conv_state_updated from CONV, state_updated from the checkpoints. No symbol, index, event or storage required knowledge outside root.yaml.

conclusions.subject: dependencies
conclusions.text: All three regions resolve locally (the check helper reports provider root with chain [root] for each), so there is no from-chain to verify. Cross-submission: start_after CONV.launch_ready is the launch permission only, triggered at kernel entry by every block including idle ones, and the data guarantee is carried separately by Handoff m (producer CONV, consumer GDN, storage global, wait_at GDN.mixed_ready = done MAIN[0]::await:conv), with the default ready point left implicit because cudaGridDependencySynchronize is exactly 'all CONV worktiles finished and their writes visible'; the two REALIZATION Require items bind the trigger/attribute pair and the sync, and the source comment confirms the attribute alone would race. await:conv sits inside if(gdn_active[i]), so inactive works produce no wait instance and read nothing conv-written, while the pre-wait prologue (geometry, state preload) touches only cu_seqlens, num_accepted_tokens, state_indices and the source state slot, none of which CONV writes. Inside CONV the three Prepared edges are each necessary: history_shift overwrites columns 0,1 which load:conv_operands may have read when off_i<=2, history_append overwrites columns 2+j for the same reason, and convolve needs both loads done; the WAR of the write-back against the row reads is covered by the burst, whose describe states done spans every row. Inside GDN the single Prepared edge (state_init after state_preload, an async_unordered load) is the only non-derivable operand edge: norm_factors and stage_operands feed the step loop through the serial await:staged barrier, delta_readout and advance follow predict by pipe order and serial mode, raw_stage/sq_stage use one slot per step so no Released edge is needed, and the checkpoint's register reuse before advance(s+1) is justified in its describe by the pack-at-issue property of the 256-bit store. carried_state is depth 1 with in-place update, whose only readers are the same thread's predict(s) (already done, serial) and the pack of the new value. Concurrent (request,head) works cannot alias on state because the fixed inputs draw all n*width slots distinctly, so the preload needs no cross-work wait; the Contract records that distinctness. Storage lifetimes close: the depth-8 step regions are written once before the loop and read only for s<len_i, weight_stage and the staged scalars survive to the output tail, and nothing is left implicitly reset.

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: The document can be read and verified without history. Contract registers every scale the Design uses (request_count, total_tokens, pool_size, spec_width, qk_head_count, value_head_count, head_dim) and every value it consumes (m, q, k, v, q_hat, k_hat, decay, beta, gate, gdn_state, len, conv_active, gdn_active); Math_reshape re-registers only what it changes or what downstream needs (sig_fast, silu_fast, invq, invk, k_hat, qdot, gdn_state, raw, sq_part) with shape, dtype and retention filled for every interface value; Work_schedule defines len_i, off_i, cb, g and the 512 tile locally; Tile_pipeline binds each noun to a named Storage view and each condition to a Contract predicate. The one shorthand not defined in Contract, `channels`, is defined explicitly at the head of the same `when` string that uses it, so Mapping.Strategy's ceil_div(channels/2,256) resolves inside the file. All ref: targets point at registered Contract attributes (mixed_qkv.dtype, conv_state.dtype, state_indices.dtype, state.dtype, norm_weight.dtype, result.dtype, state_updated.dtype) and all exist. Nothing depends on dispatch.md for meaning: the directory only records other configurations, and the retained source limitations (the unverified 3.1e-4 sigmoid bound, the threshold provenance) sit where they belong, in Arithmetic.Approx and `when`.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: Each layer stays in its place. Contract fixes the task, the four compute steps, the in-place side effects and the source-only tolerance records; no Design choice leaked into it (the 512-channel tile, the 8-slot depths and the L(8) ownership appear only downstream). Math_reshape defines values, precision and retention with no thread, warp, barrier or address content: the padded 160-slot permutation appears only as a Storage shape, the warp-per-step assignment only in an action describe, and the /1024 grouping is expressed as a mathematical identity rather than a lane count. Work_schedule fixes the two partitions, tiles, mapping, worker counts, submission order and the single Handoff, and restates neither formulas nor primitives. Tile_pipeline owns roles, actions, storage, events and edges, referring upward for every formula and for the worktile coordinates. REALIZATION adds only what upstream leaves abstract — the two PDL primitives, tanh.approx.f32 for the declared error path, the 256-thread/two-CTA residency budget that the register Storage account implies but cannot enforce, and one Prefer for the 256-bit access width — and creates no role, buffer or dependency. The directory does not override the YAML: the graph-replay, scalar-conv, vec==2, out-tail and combination records are all deltas against named root objects, and root's `when` keeps the selected configuration fixed rather than turning it into a switch.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: One concrete scheme is expressed and the input-driven cases all close. Sizes: 512 = 256 threads x 2 channels and ceil_div(channels,512)*request_count CTAs for CONV; value_head_count*request_count for GDN; both equal the launched grids. Worktile_order [request, head] with head fastest matches dim3(hv,n) linear block ids, and Preassigned {start: worker_id, count: 1} with Refill none and Exit assigned_done matches one CTA per worktile. Capacity: every depth-8 region is justified by len_i <= spec_width <= 8 from Contract, and the sq_stage group count head_dim/16 = 8 equals both the warp count and the 16-row groups. Tails and empty work stay distinct rather than collapsed: an idle CONV worktile still exists and still grants the launch permission but writes nothing; len_i=0 makes both GDN branches false so no action is produced; a gdn-inactive request with len_i>=1 produces a real zero_rows store; a checkpoint exists only where dst(s)>0; slots len_i..7 of the staged regions are neither written nor read. Storage totals equal depth x slot bytes x one CTA member for all nine regions and both register regions, and their sum matches the source declarations. The `when` conditions agree with the design body: even out strides match the paired tail store in compute:out_rows, the 32-byte state alignment matches the 256-bit load and store, and the >160 threshold matches the two-submission Flow rather than the fused design. Version 2 and the pinned Source agree with the revision actually made.

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: What is retained is needed and nothing procedural was pulled in. The five Rewrite ledgers carry only differences not visible from the formulas (read counts, state passes, retained readouts and partials, the extra barrier, the 8x-evaluated squares, the new 3.1e-4 error source against the atol 0.01/rtol 0.05 budget). The unconsumed invk is kept with an explicit statement, as extraction requires, instead of being silently dropped or promoted to a dependency. The source-claimed sigmoid bound is retained as a marked source limitation rather than asserted as verified, and the fusion-threshold provenance stays in the directory because it is a configuration boundary, not a design fact. Defensive source paths (len>8 fallback, len<=8 activity gate, the two never-launched template instances) are correctly absent from the YAML and recorded once in dispatch.md. Experiment identifiers, A/B geomeans, NCU counters and revision history from the source comments were not transcribed. Three small redundancies remain and are noted for optional P6 tidying without changing meaning: a few equivalence and rationale sentences sit inside Rewrite[].Math (root.yaml lines 150, 161-162, 184) where DOC3 would prefer Thesis or Ledger; the unconsumed-invk remark appears both in Math and in the Symbol meaning; and store:history_shift is declared serial while its sibling store:history_append is async_unordered, which is stricter than the source needs but costs nothing because compute:convolve(j) already waits on both loads.

conclusions.subject: contract
conclusions.text: 共享 Algorithm_requirement 忠实于固定来源，且读者不看 Design 即可写出朴素参考计算。任务身份与来源：Name 沿用题目名（不含 tile/架构/分支），Describe 一句话无性能或优化结论，META_DATA.Source 与 Golden_reference.Source 分别精确等于本次 implementation_source 与 reference_source，两个入口均实际存在、职责分离，未用设计源码冒充参考入口，也未把生产 baseline（QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention._forward_core_decode_spec_fused_norm，其原库 validation.status=numerical_failure）当作正确性依据。逐条对照 reference.py 的 fault=None 路径核实：Compute[0] 的 cu_seqlens 分段、len/conv_active/gdn_active 与参考 active 条件（0<len<=8、0<accepted<=width、s[accepted-1]>0）等价，且 conv_active 取槽表列 0、gdn_active 取列 accepted-1，两者相互独立（覆盖 conv 非活跃而 gdn 活跃、以及 api_null 的槽零化）；Compute[1] 的 off=accepted-1、三列历史+当前 token 的 4 抽头 FP32 累加、silu 后 BF16 写回、conv_state 列 0/1 取 stored off+1/off+2、列 2+j 追加调用前原始 token、写回范围前 len+2 列，与参考的 hist/stream/unfold/copy_ 及 conv_state[slot,:,:len+2] 逐项一致；Compute[2] 的 q/k/v 列偏移、q_hat 含 scale 而 k_hat 不含、eps=1e-6、decay（softplus 阈值 20）、beta、gate 双分支、ratio 与 repeat_interleave 等价的 floor(j/ratio)；Compute[3] 的 out 缺省分配+全量清零、gdn_state(0) 取调用开始时源槽 FP32 值（对应 carried=state[src].float() 物化）、pred/delta/状态更新、更新后 raw 读出、rsqrt(mean(raw^2)+norm_eps)*norm_weight*gate 后 BF16、仅正槽逐步写 BF16 检查点、非活跃请求零行不写状态、返回 out 即 result。另独立复核候选实现在每个常量与数据版本上与之一致：invq=rsqrtf(pq+1e-6f)*scale 而 invk 不含 scale、sp = x>20?x:log1pf(expf(x))、decay=expf(-expf(A_log)*sp)、g=j/ratio、qbase/kbase/vbase 偏移、d=(v-p*decay)*beta、raw=diq*q+d*dk 展开即 sum_c gdn_state(s+1)*q_hat、S=fmaf(d,k_hat,S*dec)、dst>0 才以 pack2（__float22bfloat162_rn，RNE）存检查点、rv=rsqrtf(tot/1024+norm_eps)。实现限制（len<=8 活跃门、vec∈{0..3} 对齐档位、conv 通道连续与 conv_weight.stride(0)==4 等 TORCH_CHECK）未升格为算法前提；spec_width<=8、request_count<=256、pool_size>request_count*spec_width、tp/head_ratio 头数关联均取自 shape_range 与 metadata 的声明。nullable/default 依实际来源：out nullable+default None 且 Compute 明确两分支与清零；scale/norm_eps/output_gate_activation 按签名默认登记，未被生成器实际传值（norm_eps=1e-06、'sigmoid'）收窄；浮点输入未添加 range，保留“任意有限值”默认域，未以 domain 采样值排除合法输入；A_log 按小写具名登记键规则写作 a_log，未丢失任何已有声明。省略 Gap 与参考入口无已知差异的核实结果一致。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: 逐输出验收对应完整，范围材料与执行单元登记均已覆盖。Output 登记 result/mixed_qkv_updated/conv_state_updated/state_updated，与 metadata 的 mutates_inputs=[mixed_qkv,conv_state,state,out] 及 input.py writable_views 声明的调用者可见写区域一一对应（out 全量、mixed_qkv 仅 state_indices[:,0]>0 且 end>begin 的请求行、conv_state 仅活跃槽前 len+2 列、state 仅被写正值槽），原地写回在各 meaning 中写明，内部 workspace 未被登记为输出。Tolerance 四键精确覆盖全部契约输出，逐条保留来源声明的比较器与阈值 torch.allclose(atol=0.01, rtol=0.05) 与 max_mismatch_fraction=0.0，并以 “Source only ... no defaults” 明确未采用 DOC1 的默认判据解释，未遗漏、未替换、未编造。本次 acceptance 绑定入口 CERTIFIED_BEST.json 只是性能认证（fixed/domain 时延、geomean、full_pass），其 release.checker_change 仅声明 “comparator/tolerances unchanged” 并以 sha256 指认 checker；对整个算子目录检索 tolerance.relative_to 无任何命中，故 comparisons 正确地为 []。scope 材料按其声明分层使用：shape_range.json 的 tp{1,2,4,8}、head_ratio{2,3,8}、width 1..8、lengths（1..256 项、每项 0..8）、pool_size 2..2048、state_dtype 固定 bf16、accepted_mode{cycle,last} 与三条 cross_field_invariants 已进入 Compute[0] 与 Input.range；shape_cases.json 的 10 个用例按 metadata 声明只作代表样本（已核对用例 9 的 api_null、width=4、含 0 长度请求），未被当作完整支持域；pool_size 上限 2048、slot padding、slot_pattern 与 domain 采样值未写入 Contract，避免以生成器能力收窄外部有效域。Execution 依固定源码最小登记 thread/warp/cta/grid，并在所属单元摘要登记 Storage.location 需引用的存储名与范围（register/smem/global），每项均有来源（warp_sum 的 __shfl_xor_sync 蝶形归约、__shared__ sm_q/sm_k/sm_v/sm_g/sm_w 等块内暂存、per-thread float S[4][16] 寄存器状态、blockDim=dim3(256) 与 conv/gdn 两处 launch、跨网格 cudaGridDependencySynchronize 与设备级标志）；256 线程被明确限定为固定来源事实而非设备上限，纯存储未单列为执行者。硬件区其余字段与 DESIGN 三区原样保留 starter 占位，未开展硬件资料调查，也未把占位或跳过检查当作能力/容量保证。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: 仅凭当前 root.yaml 即可独立理解标准答案，无需历史上下文或目录补写。三个 Constant 与六个运行时规模（total_tokens、pool_size、request_count、spec_width、qk_head_count、value_head_count）都在 Input shape 首次引入、并在 Compute[0] 给出取值范围与相互关系（cu_seqlens 端点与非降、total_tokens=sum len[i]>=1、len[i]<=spec_width<=8、1<=request_count<=256、pool_size>request_count*spec_width、qk_head_count*tp=16 与 value_head_count=qk_head_count*head_ratio）；17 个 Input 的 meaning/shape/dtype 齐备，nullable/default/range 按条件填写，非张量标量以 python_float/python_str 登记；四个 Compute 依先定义后使用排列，归约轴（sum_c、sum_r 跨 [0,head_dim)）、被公式省略的独立轴（请求与值头独立）、递推初值与索引（gdn_state(0)、s=0..len[i]-1、t=cu_seqlens[i]+s）、分支条件（conv_active/gdn_active、state_indices>0、out 是否为 None、gate 激活名）与边界（len[i]=0 的空请求、无活跃请求时返回已清零 out、未触碰区域）均显式写出，softplus 与 silu/sigmoid 的分段或函数定义在使用处给出；12 个 Symbol 登记了跨步骤引用对象，m 以 ref:mixed_qkv.shape 引用已登记 Input，引用可解析且不成环。唯一不能自足之处是外部验收器的公式、归一化与非有限值处理，已按验收来源记录在 Tolerance 标注为 Source only/no defaults 并在 issue 保留缺项、来源与补齐途径，不需读者靠隐含定义补足。DESIGN 未完成属 P1 允许范围，不影响本阶段内容的可独立理解性。

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: 分层正确，下层未补入或改写上层决定。CONTRACT.Algorithm_requirement 只表达调用者视角的输入输出、有效域、数学关系、精度转换与副作用，未混入任何 Design 内容：没有 tile/分块尺寸、kernel 数量、CTA 或 grid 配置、chunk 大小、缓冲槽数、执行顺序、PDL/程序化依赖、CUDA-graph 缓存或 vec 对齐档位；四个 Compute 按输入输出关系组织，未按源码的 kernel 或优化步骤划分。FP32 累加与 bf16() 舍入点属于改变数值的算法精度边界（并由 metadata 的 reference-materialization-v1 数值合同固定），正确地留在 Contract 而非 Design；数学中间量（stream、acc、m、q_hat/k_hat/v、decay、beta、gate、gdn_state）只定义逻辑关系，未要求物化或规定保存策略，Symbol 也无 retention。候选实现的选择性事实未被升格为算法前提：len<=8 活跃门、acc_ok 防御、TORCH_CHECK 的 stride/连续性/对齐要求、256 线程 launch、tanh.approx 快速 sigmoid 均只作为核实证据使用，未出现在 Contract 正文。Execution 的最小登记位于 Hardware_specification 而非 Design，键为小写单元名、值为一句话摘要，存储名与范围写在所属单元摘要中供 Storage.location 沿用，纯存储未单列为执行者，也没有把设备级数量或容量写入本区；硬件区其余字段与 DESIGN 三区原样保留 starter 占位，符合 P1 第 3 段豁免。本次未创建 dispatch 目录或其他 YAML，不存在目录覆盖 YAML 的情形。

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: 全文一致，一份 YAML 表达一套共享 Contract。名称在契约内唯一：17 个 Input、4 个 Output、3 个 Constant、12 个 Symbol 与 6 个规模名互不碰撞（输出刻意命名为 result/mixed_qkv_updated/conv_state_updated/state_updated 以避开与同名输入冲突，与调用者张量 out/mixed_qkv/conv_state/state 的对应关系写在各自 meaning 与 Compute[1]/[3] 中，未丢失任何已有声明）；每个 shape 内轴名唯一，通道表达式 (2*qk_head_count + value_head_count)*head_dim 在 mixed_qkv/conv_state/conv_weight 与两个 *_updated 输出中写法一致，pool 轴在 conv_state 与 state 中同名同值，head_dim 在 state 的 row/col 与 norm_weight/output_gate/out 的 d 轴一致。整数表达式在有效域内均得整数（整除条件由 Compute[0] 的 tp/head_ratio 关联与 Compute[2] 的 ratio 为正整数保证，history=spec_width+2、bound=request_count+1 为加法），无隐含截断。按输入引起的尺寸与工作量照常核对：len[i]=0 的请求无 token、既不写 out 行也不写状态；conv 非活跃而 gdn 活跃时 m 等于调用前值；无活跃请求时全部 out 已清零并直接返回；len[i]=spec_width 时未触碰列区间为空——这些情形分别与“未提交/没有工作/已执行动作”区分清楚，未把 no-op 与实际写入混淆。副作用贯通：Compute[1] 声明的写入区域与 Output 的三个 *_updated 范围吻合，未触碰条款（len+2..spec_width+1 列、非活跃槽、其他 mixed_qkv 行、声明视图外的 backing/guards/padding）与 metadata 的 gate/backing must remain untouched、preserve_input_storage 及任意 slot padding 要求一致，且覆盖了 mixed_qkv 与 output_gate 共享 guarded backing 这一实际布局。数据版本无矛盾：conv 读调用前的 mixed_qkv 与 conv_state，检查点与 out 均由更新后的 FP32 gdn_state(s+1) 得出（out 不读 BF16 检查点），gdn_state(0) 取调用开始时的源槽值，正槽互异保证跨请求不相互覆盖。检查器 raw_passed=true、corrections 与 diagnostics 均空，与人工核对结果一致。

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: 内容必要，无过程残留。YAML 中不含退修记录、待办、历史批准、实验数据、性能结论或重复决定；Describe 一句话不含优化理由；META_DATA.Source 只记录真实设计依据，未写任务进度或验证状态；metadata 的 validation.status=numerical_failure 与 CERTIFIED_BEST 的时延数据都未被搬进 Contract。保留的每一项都影响理解或结果：'as stored before this call'、'stored conv_state[s,c,off+1]'、'gdn_state(0) ... as of call start'、'the readout after the update' 固定了会改变数值的数据版本；'Untouched: ... storage outside the declared views (backing, guards, padding)' 对应外部声明的 gate/backing 不可触碰与任意 padding 支持；state_indices 的正值互异与 pool_size 不变量是源槽与检查点槽不相互覆盖的前提；qk_head_count*tp=16 与 head_ratio 关联是外部声明的 model/ABI 约束而非实现细节；softplus 阈值 20 与 silu/sigmoid 定义是数值定义所必需。研究取舍与规范允许的来源缺口未被当作无关过程删除：外部验收器公式/归一化缺失按验收来源记录保留在四条 Tolerance 中（Source only ... no defaults），未挪入 Golden_reference.Gap，也未新增 YAML 字段。短文本只写设计重点，命名清楚常见（conv_active/gdn_active/q_hat/k_hat/gdn_state/decay/beta/gate 等），无生僻自造缩写；具体字数、大小写与排版交 Template，本次 raw 无需人工精简的超长正文。

issues.detail: 冻结材料只声明验收标签，未提供外部验收器本身：metadata.json 的 description 给出 upstream torch.allclose(reference_float, candidate_float, atol=0.01, rtol=0.05)，benchmark_contract.correctness_tolerances.default 补充 max_mismatch_fraction=0.0（且只有 default 一档、无逐输出判据）；本次 acceptance 绑定入口 CERTIFIED_BEST.json 仅为性能认证（fixed/domain 时延、geomean_us、full_pass），其 release.checker_change 只声明 comparator/tolerances unchanged 并以 sha256 指认 checker。外部比较器实现、逐输出归一化、相对误差基准与非有限值处理均不在快照内，全目录检索亦无 tolerance.relative_to 声明，故 comparisons=[]。经核实该缺口只影响外部测试通过边界的复现：任务数学、输入输出、全部副作用、精度转换与参考入口均可完全确定，四个输出的写区域另可由 input.py 的 writable_views/observable_inputs 佐证；四条 Tolerance 已完整保留来源声明的比较器与阈值并标注 “Source only ... no defaults”，未采用 DOC1 的默认 atol/rtol 解释，也未借此假定任何数值保证或省略源码已给事实。确认 worker 回执中的同名 source_gap 记录，限制须随交付保留；不新增 YAML 字段，也不挪入 Golden_reference.Gap。此项不阻塞 P1 放行。
issues.recovery_condition: 任务方提供外部验收器实现或逐输出完整判据（完整公式、relative_to 基准、归一化范围、非有限值处理与检查路由）后，将四条 Tolerance 由来源记录改写为完整判据，回填 comparisons 的 output/source_output 绑定，并复核受影响的输出对应关系。
issues.scope: root.yaml CONTRACT.Algorithm_requirement.Golden_reference.Tolerance（result / mixed_qkv_updated / conv_state_updated / state_updated 四条）

conclusions.subject: mechanisms
conclusions.text: 机制概览忠实于固定源码，本人沿 Model.forward→gdn_forward→gdn_launch→六个 kernel 全文追踪独立核实：(1) 主计算两段——conv 段以 (request, channel chunk) 为工作（slot=state_indices[i,0]、off=accepted-1 三列历史与本请求 len 行 mixed 拼流、4 抽头 FP32 顺序累加后 silu、就地 BF16 写回 mixed、调用前原始 token 追加 conv_state 列 2..len+1、列 0/1 移为旧 off+1/off+2）；gdn 段以 (request, value head) 为一个 256 线程 CTA 跑完全部 len 步，8 warp 分摊 128 行、状态 FP32 常驻寄存器，每步 pred/delta/更新、正槽 BF16 检查点，RMSNorm 延迟到步循环后一次 barrier 汇总再按 (step,channel) 写 out。(2) 输出形成：out/result 与 state 检查点只在 gdn 段产生，conv 段只原地改写 mixed_qkv 与 conv_state（即 Contract 的另两个输出）；len=0 块直接返回、非活跃块写零 len*128 个 out 元素、活跃块尾段写满 len*128——out 每个元素有确定生产者，未与 no-op 混淆；len>8 回退与 len<=8 活跃门在域内为空/恒真，属防御路径。(3) 段间交接两套实现：两提交 PDL（消费者带 ProgrammaticStreamSerialization、块内 cudaGridDependencySynchronize 在读 mixed 前、生产者 trigger——conv3 在入口、conv_kernel 在末端，触发位置只改重叠窗口不改数值与依赖）；单提交融合（conv 角色无条件 threadfence+到达计数且从不等待、gdn 角色 conv 无关 prologue 提前后 tid0 有限自旋 flags[i]>=cxb、离开计数、第 hv 个到达者自复位；无 kernel 边界故 mixed 一律 ld.global.cg 读到 L2 一致点，其余输入不被 conv 写用普通读）。(4) gdn 块内两套归属-归约组织：L(8)（4 行×16 列、160 宽重映射 smem、b2s 一步一 warp 算 invq/invk/dotk 并暂存 q/k_hat、8 lane 三级 shfl_xor、折叠读出 raw=diq*q+d*dk 等价于更新后 S_new·q_hat、尾段 1/1024）与 v1（16 行×4 列、128 宽 smem、循环内乘 invk/invq、每行两次整 warp 蝶形、更新后直接读出、b1 全量+b2 冗余重算+两次 barrier、尾段 1/128）。(5) 提交方式另有单槽图重放：捕获只记录执行结构，重放在当前流重新执行同一序列读当前内存，副作用照常，失败/64 次未命中永久回落——录图不等于缓存结果。(6) 数值表示线索（tanh.approx 快速 sigmoid 喂 conv silu/gate/beta、decay/softplus 精确）核实为三份设计共有取舍而非区分机制。草案对上述全部的转写与定性无实质错误。

conclusions.subject: root_choice
conclusions.text: root 选择成立且为真实源码实例：两 launch PDL 路径在 conv_vec&&vec==3 的实例——conv3_kernel<<<dim3((channels/2+255)/256,n),256,0,stream>>> + cudaLaunchKernelEx(&cfg, gdn_w11v8_kernel<true>, GDN_ARGS)（cfg.gridDim=dim3(hv,n)、blockDim=256、attrs=ProgrammaticStreamSerialization），launch 身份与源码 1746-1753/1763/1794-1803 逐字段一致，非拼接的虚拟基线。选择依据有据：10 个固定用例中 8 例实际进入该实例（shape0/5 之外全部），ncu 记录该 8 例每次捕获均为 conv3_kernel+gdn_w11v8_kernel<(bool)1>，CERTIFIED_BEST fixed/domain 双套件 full_pass、status=certified，SELECTION 确认被认证 entry 即本 candidate/solution.py——“认证测量覆盖的主实例”成立。接口最清楚（两段各一次提交、跨段依赖只由 PDL 表达）便于理解比较；草案明确其不追求最通用、不充当另两份祖先（融合改提交与协作、v1 改块内归属与归约，均非 root 加参数可得），符合 root 选择规则。META_DATA.Source 已精确指向本次 implementation_source 且 P2 未改 root.yaml（digest 与 P1 批准一致），初步承担范围（vec==3、conv_vec、不满足融合门限）与 use_fk/vec 判定互补，精确 when 依阶段规则留 P3 写实。

conclusions.subject: selection
conclusions.text: 拟完整集合 3 份（含 root，≤10），逐份独立核对新增机制与降级判据后认可。fused_single_launch 相对 root 新增：一次提交内按线性 blockIdx.x 划分 conv/gdn 两角色（工作归属与 gdn 排列 i*hv+j 改变）、设备侧到达/离开原子计数+tid0 有界自旋替代 PDL 网格依赖（主协作改变）、空/非活跃请求也参与计数（完成关系改变）、grow-only 零初始化标志缓冲跨调用存续且指针入图键（跨工作寿命改变）、无 kernel 边界带来的 ld.global.cg/L2 一致点要求（新增一致性必要条件）——提交结构、依赖与事件体系全部重构，root 主体加差额说明不足以表达，保留完整设计正确。warp_row_reduction 相对 root 新增：线程↔状态归属转置（4 行×16 列→16 行×4 列）、归约范围改变（8 lane 三级 shfl→每行整 warp 蝶形×2/步）、读出路径改变（折叠式→更新后直接读出、无 dotk 预计算）、暂存组织（b2s/b2k→b1 全量+b2 冗余重算、barrier 一次→两次）与尾段归一因子 1/1024→1/128——整条步循环协作与输出形成路径需重新贯通，且是源码为 vec==1/0 档实际选用的方案（注释记录 29.4/27.0us 对 53.5/45.1us 的性能依据），不是 root 参数变体，保留完整设计正确。降级 5 项层级判断均与 common 判据相符：标量 conv_kernel 围绕 root CONV 提交即可说清通道粒度/访问宽度/预取取消/触发位置且主体组织不变（局部）；gdn_w11_kernel<true> 与 root 逐段对比仅状态预载/检查点的访问指令与对齐要求不同、布局公式归约 barrier 与检查点字节图像全同（参数）；out 尾段配对/标量存储乘积与顺序相同值不变、三份设计尾段共用（参数）；图重放只改提交方式、设备工作与副作用不变、共同差额写一次并链接三基线（局部）；conv 档与 gdn 档判定取自不同张量互相独立、接口相容不按配对建节点（组合）。没有把应贯通的独立方案改称参数；w11v8<false>/w11<false> 从不启动属死代码、正确排除；未发现第四套需要贯通的主计算/输出形成/工作分配/主协作组织。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: 全部已识别机制与档位有明确去处、调查止点成立：gdn 四个对齐档（vec==3→root、vec==2→root 参数记录、vec==1/0→warp_row_reduction 及其自身两档）与 conv 两档（conv3→root/fused、conv_kernel→局部记录）全覆盖，组合记录说明两轴独立且融合被门限绑死，未按 2×4 配对建节点；shape_range 对 state/conv slot padding（0..65536）无奇偶约束且 input.py 的 as_strided 构造给出实际 stride，故低对齐档与标量 conv 在任务有效域内可达——“只在任意 slot padding 下进入、固定用例未覆盖”的域论证经我按 padding=4/1/8 独立重算成立。测量边界如实：固定 10 例全部 vec==3+conv_vec（padding∈{32,4096,65536}），shape0（convTotal=20*8=160）与 shape5（4*32=128）命中门限，与 ncu 逐例吻合；我对 performance 全目录检索确认 gdn_w11_kernel/gdn_v1_kernel/conv_kernel 零执行记录（kernel 名 90 条=10 fk+40 conv3+40 w11v8<(bool)1>，与 kernel_counts 一致），草案未据源码分支推断未测组合性能。来源限制均有去向且不升格为硬件保证：门限 160（~0.55×296 常驻容量+ab3/ab7/ab9 实测声称）、块按线性 ID 顺序派发为 de facto、标志缓冲全零前提、.cg 一致性要求、快速 sigmoid 误差界为源码声称未验证——P3/P5 按来源事实记录的指令明确；外部验收器缺失沿用 P1 source_gap issue，只影响外部通过边界，已知阈值（atol=0.01/rtol=0.05/max_mismatch_fraction=0.0）完整保留在 Tolerance 来源记录中，不再次阻塞。P1 已完成内容（Contract 四步数学、域约束、nullable/default、四输出与未触碰条款、Golden_reference 与 Execution 最小登记、硬件占位）经我对照 reference/input/metadata/shape_range 独立复核无错，未发现需返回 P1 的具体事实；root.yaml 本次未被改动，符合 P2 可写范围。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: 当前产物可独立理解：dispatch.md 按唯一最小格式组织（范围/完整设计/变体与组合三节齐备），范围段自足地交代实现范围、host 判定轴、固定用例覆盖、副作用边界与未知限制，无需历史会话即可读懂；完整设计表三行各自给出具体机制、保留理由与关系，root 链接指向实际存在的 root.yaml，两份未来文件按规则用普通文本文件名并标“仅计划”、只获计划认可；五条记录均含基线/差异与联动/条件与依据三信息项，基线定位到 root.yaml 及暂拟对象名（“暂拟 step 名 CONV/GDN”已明示暂定、P4 替换为真实对象），未依赖目录补写 YAML 或旧稿补足含义。root.yaml 的 P1 内容自足性沿 P1 结论并经本次复核：规模/符号/分支/边界/数据版本均可在 Contract 内定位，Tolerance 来源记录明确标注未采用默认解释。

conclusions.subject: document_layering

conclusions.subject: design
conclusions.text: root.yaml's Math_reshape, Work_schedule, Tile_pipeline and REALIZATION are complete local definitions of the P2-selected instance and are faithful to the fixed source in every relation I checked. Math: sig_fast/silu_fast reproduce fmaf(0.5, tanh.approx.f32(0.5x), 0.5) and are applied to the conv SiLU, both gate branches and beta while exp/log1p/rsqrt stay on the accurate path; conv accumulation is left-to-right over the four taps with the pre-call word (not the convolved value) appended to column 2+j and columns 0,1 copied from off_i+1/off_i+2; invq/invk/qdot are per-(t,g) scalars with k_hat materialized and q_hat never formed per element; raw = decay*invq*qsum + delta*qdot is algebraically the Contract readout of gdn_state(s+1) with q_hat=invq*q and k_hat=invk*k substituted; the advance is the source's fma32(delta, k_hat, gdn_state(s)*decay); rv = rsqrt(sum_gp sq_part/1024 + norm_eps) equals rsqrt(sum_r raw^2/head_dim + norm_eps) precisely because sq_part carries each row's square 8 times. Ledger gains and costs are all checkable against the formulas (window reads 4*len_i -> len_i+3, state passes 4 -> 2, retained len_i*head_dim readouts plus len_i*head_dim/16 partials and one extra barrier). Work: CONV is (request, 512-channel block) with ceil_div(channels,512)*request_count CTAs and GDN is (request, value head) with value_head_count*request_count CTAs, matching the dim3((channels/2+255)/256, n) and dim3(hv, n) grids of 256 threads; the steps stay a local iteration so the sequential state axis is inside one work; two Launch entries with start_after CONV.launch_ready and a single Handoff of m with wait_at GDN.mixed_ready reproduce the two submissions and the PDL join. Pipeline: one synchronous MAIN role per submission, storage account exactly equal to the source (23488 B smem across the 13 arrays consolidated into 9 regions, 32768 B state_preload and 65536 B carried_state in registers), q/k staged in the padded 160-wide permutation, all eight depth-8 regions justified by len_i <= spec_width <= 8. REALIZATION passes the deletion test on all five items and re-decides nothing upstream. The only defects I found are non-semantic and are recorded in the handoff rather than as issues.

conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: Traced fixed case 1 end to end: tp=1, head_ratio=2, width=8, 32 requests each of length 8 (total_tokens=256), h=16, hv=32, channels=8192, state_slot_padding=65536, conv_slot_padding=4096, accepted_mode=last. Host: h=(8192-32*128)/256=16, ratio=2; state strides 589824/16384/128 are all divisible by 16 on a 32-byte aligned base so vec=3; channels, css=86016, csp=8192 and ms0=12288 are even with 4-byte aligned conv_state/mixed and a 16-byte aligned conv_weight so conv_vec holds; ms0 and gs0 are divisible by 4 and out strides 4096/128 are even; fk_conv_total=16*32=512>160 so fk_flags is null and the two-launch branch runs — every clause of root's `when` is satisfied and the fused design is correctly excluded. Submission 1 is 512 CTAs (16 channel blocks x 32 requests) and submission 2 is 1024 CTAs (32 heads x 32 requests), matching both Worker_count fields. A CONV CTA grants launch permission at entry, then for conv_active[i] bursts the 8 pre-call 4-byte mixed words per channel pair, reads history columns 7,8,9 plus the uint4 of taps, copies columns 8,9 into columns 0,1, and for j=0..7 accumulates left to right, applies silu_fast, writes the packed BF16 pair over mixed and appends the pre-call word to column 2+j, so all ten history columns of the slot become exactly the Contract's conv_state_updated view. A GDN CTA (j,i) reads geometry, preloads four 256-bit row tiles of state[state_indices[i,7],j] into 32 registers per thread, waits on the grid dependency, has warp s reduce step s into invq/invk/qdot while staging raw q and k_hat, stages v, gate (sigmoid branch, since the fixed inputs pass output_gate_activation='sigmoid'), norm_weight, decay, beta and dst, crosses the single barrier, widens the preload into S[4][16], then for s=0..7 accumulates pred and qsum in one pass over 16 columns x 4 rows, reduces across the 8 column-block lanes in 3 levels, forms delta and raw, publishes raw and sq_part, advances the state and checkpoints all eight positive slots; the closing barrier is followed by the tail writing 8*128 out elements as 4-byte pairs with rv from the 8 group partials. Every Contract output has a determined producer: result from the active tail or the inactive zero path (and no row at all when len_i=0), mixed_qkv_updated and conv_state_updated from CONV, state_updated from the checkpoints. No symbol, index, event or storage required knowledge outside root.yaml.

conclusions.subject: dependencies
conclusions.text: All three regions resolve locally (the check helper reports provider root with chain [root] for each), so there is no from-chain to verify. Cross-submission: start_after CONV.launch_ready is the launch permission only, triggered at kernel entry by every block including idle ones, and the data guarantee is carried separately by Handoff m (producer CONV, consumer GDN, storage global, wait_at GDN.mixed_ready = done MAIN[0]::await:conv), with the default ready point left implicit because cudaGridDependencySynchronize is exactly 'all CONV worktiles finished and their writes visible'; the two REALIZATION Require items bind the trigger/attribute pair and the sync, and the source comment confirms the attribute alone would race. await:conv sits inside if(gdn_active[i]), so inactive works produce no wait instance and read nothing conv-written, while the pre-wait prologue (geometry, state preload) touches only cu_seqlens, num_accepted_tokens, state_indices and the source state slot, none of which CONV writes. Inside CONV the three Prepared edges are each necessary: history_shift overwrites columns 0,1 which load:conv_operands may have read when off_i<=2, history_append overwrites columns 2+j for the same reason, and convolve needs both loads done; the WAR of the write-back against the row reads is covered by the burst, whose describe states done spans every row. Inside GDN the single Prepared edge (state_init after state_preload, an async_unordered load) is the only non-derivable operand edge: norm_factors and stage_operands feed the step loop through the serial await:staged barrier, delta_readout and advance follow predict by pipe order and serial mode, raw_stage/sq_stage use one slot per step so no Released edge is needed, and the checkpoint's register reuse before advance(s+1) is justified in its describe by the pack-at-issue property of the 256-bit store. carried_state is depth 1 with in-place update, whose only readers are the same thread's predict(s) (already done, serial) and the pack of the new value. Concurrent (request,head) works cannot alias on state because the fixed inputs draw all n*width slots distinctly, so the preload needs no cross-work wait; the Contract records that distinctness. Storage lifetimes close: the depth-8 step regions are written once before the loop and read only for s<len_i, weight_stage and the staged scalars survive to the output tail, and nothing is left implicitly reset.

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: The document can be read and verified without history. Contract registers every scale the Design uses (request_count, total_tokens, pool_size, spec_width, qk_head_count, value_head_count, head_dim) and every value it consumes (m, q, k, v, q_hat, k_hat, decay, beta, gate, gdn_state, len, conv_active, gdn_active); Math_reshape re-registers only what it changes or what downstream needs (sig_fast, silu_fast, invq, invk, k_hat, qdot, gdn_state, raw, sq_part) with shape, dtype and retention filled for every interface value; Work_schedule defines len_i, off_i, cb, g and the 512 tile locally; Tile_pipeline binds each noun to a named Storage view and each condition to a Contract predicate. The one shorthand not defined in Contract, `channels`, is defined explicitly at the head of the same `when` string that uses it, so Mapping.Strategy's ceil_div(channels/2,256) resolves inside the file. All ref: targets point at registered Contract attributes (mixed_qkv.dtype, conv_state.dtype, state_indices.dtype, state.dtype, norm_weight.dtype, result.dtype, state_updated.dtype) and all exist. Nothing depends on dispatch.md for meaning: the directory only records other configurations, and the retained source limitations (the unverified 3.1e-4 sigmoid bound, the threshold provenance) sit where they belong, in Arithmetic.Approx and `when`.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: Each layer stays in its place. Contract fixes the task, the four compute steps, the in-place side effects and the source-only tolerance records; no Design choice leaked into it (the 512-channel tile, the 8-slot depths and the L(8) ownership appear only downstream). Math_reshape defines values, precision and retention with no thread, warp, barrier or address content: the padded 160-slot permutation appears only as a Storage shape, the warp-per-step assignment only in an action describe, and the /1024 grouping is expressed as a mathematical identity rather than a lane count. Work_schedule fixes the two partitions, tiles, mapping, worker counts, submission order and the single Handoff, and restates neither formulas nor primitives. Tile_pipeline owns roles, actions, storage, events and edges, referring upward for every formula and for the worktile coordinates. REALIZATION adds only what upstream leaves abstract — the two PDL primitives, tanh.approx.f32 for the declared error path, the 256-thread/two-CTA residency budget that the register Storage account implies but cannot enforce, and one Prefer for the 256-bit access width — and creates no role, buffer or dependency. The directory does not override the YAML: the graph-replay, scalar-conv, vec==2, out-tail and combination records are all deltas against named root objects, and root's `when` keeps the selected configuration fixed rather than turning it into a switch.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: One concrete scheme is expressed and the input-driven cases all close. Sizes: 512 = 256 threads x 2 channels and ceil_div(channels,512)*request_count CTAs for CONV; value_head_count*request_count for GDN; both equal the launched grids. Worktile_order [request, head] with head fastest matches dim3(hv,n) linear block ids, and Preassigned {start: worker_id, count: 1} with Refill none and Exit assigned_done matches one CTA per worktile. Capacity: every depth-8 region is justified by len_i <= spec_width <= 8 from Contract, and the sq_stage group count head_dim/16 = 8 equals both the warp count and the 16-row groups. Tails and empty work stay distinct rather than collapsed: an idle CONV worktile still exists and still grants the launch permission but writes nothing; len_i=0 makes both GDN branches false so no action is produced; a gdn-inactive request with len_i>=1 produces a real zero_rows store; a checkpoint exists only where dst(s)>0; slots len_i..7 of the staged regions are neither written nor read. Storage totals equal depth x slot bytes x one CTA member for all nine regions and both register regions, and their sum matches the source declarations. The `when` conditions agree with the design body: even out strides match the paired tail store in compute:out_rows, the 32-byte state alignment matches the 256-bit load and store, and the >160 threshold matches the two-submission Flow rather than the fused design. Version 2 and the pinned Source agree with the revision actually made.

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: What is retained is needed and nothing procedural was pulled in. The five Rewrite ledgers carry only differences not visible from the formulas (read counts, state passes, retained readouts and partials, the extra barrier, the 8x-evaluated squares, the new 3.1e-4 error source against the atol 0.01/rtol 0.05 budget). The unconsumed invk is kept with an explicit statement, as extraction requires, instead of being silently dropped or promoted to a dependency. The source-claimed sigmoid bound is retained as a marked source limitation rather than asserted as verified, and the fusion-threshold provenance stays in the directory because it is a configuration boundary, not a design fact. Defensive source paths (len>8 fallback, len<=8 activity gate, the two never-launched template instances) are correctly absent from the YAML and recorded once in dispatch.md. Experiment identifiers, A/B geomeans, NCU counters and revision history from the source comments were not transcribed. Three small redundancies remain and are noted for optional P6 tidying without changing meaning: a few equivalence and rationale sentences sit inside Rewrite[].Math (root.yaml lines 150, 161-162, 184) where DOC3 would prefer Thesis or Ledger; the unconsumed-invk remark appears both in Math and in the Symbol meaning; and store:history_shift is declared serial while its sibling store:history_append is async_unordered, which is stricter than the source needs but costs nothing because compute:convolve(j) already waits on both loads.

conclusions.subject: directory
conclusions.text: 本次为回执补正，我先核对当前 workspace 与上轮批准对象机械同一（dispatch.md 第 23/27 行仍为修正后文本、root.yaml raw_sha256 f80d48b8… 与 effective_identity 4a3a9cd6… 未变、helper exit 0），判断未变。上轮唯一 issue 已修正并经我独立核实：第 23 行导语与第 27 行 root 行机制列的“16B 对齐档实例”已改为“vec==3 档实例（state 三 stride 16 元素整除、基址 32B 对齐）”，导语并就近指向记录 (b) 中 root 侧那一档；源码依据为 a8（三 stride %8==0 且 data_ptr&15u==0，即 16B 基址）→vec==2、a16（三 stride %16==0 且 data_ptr&31u==0，即 32B 基址）→vec==3、vec=a16?3:(a8?2:(a4?1:0))，w11v8 的 256 位预载注释明写“32B alignment guaranteed by the a16 gate”，kernel 选择注释把“uint4 state access, 16B-aligned strides”归给 vec==2 的 W11；root.yaml 的 when（divisible by 16 + 32-byte aligned base）与 Prefer 理由句（32-byte alignment）与新标签逐项吻合，第 9 行档位定义、第 42-43 行记录 (b)、第 60 行组合记录全文一致（第 10/37 行保留的“conv_weight 16B 对齐”是 conv_vec 的另一判据，正确地未改）。非阻塞建议亦已采纳：第 27 行 when 摘要补出 output_gate.stride(1)。目录其余内容我已重读全文并确认仍成立：保持 common 的唯一最小格式（范围/完整设计/变体与组合，无空小节），收录 root 加两份“仅计划”代表共 3 份（远低于十份上限、普通文本文件名、无可点击假链接、未提前建文件，检查器 yaml_files=[root.yaml]、planned_nodes 两份），五条记录（局部/参数/参数/局部/组合）均直接定位 root.yaml v2 的真实对象（Work_schedule::CONV 的 Partition.channel 与 Worker_count、Tile_pipeline::CONV.MAIN 的 token_rows/conv_operands 与五个动作、Tile_pipeline::GDN 的 load:state_preload/store:checkpoint 与 REALIZATION.Prefer、GDN.MAIN 的 compute:out_rows 与 Math_reshape 的延迟 RMSNorm 写出式、Flow.Launch 两条与 Flow.Handoff::m），不以行号或源码局部数组名当修改地址。差额与联动逐条对源码核实仍成立：标量 conv（1 通道/线程、grid ceil_div(channels,256)、取消 8 行预取、trigger 移到循环之后、同一 sigmoidf 与同一左到右累加序故两个 conv 输出值不变，触发位置只缩小消费者 prologue 的重叠窗口）；vec==2 档（gdn_w11_kernel 与 gdn_w11v8_kernel 全文对比只差状态预载与检查点的访问宽度，smem 声明含 160 宽 sm_q/sm_k、b2s/b1、三级 shfl 归约、尾段 1/1024 与 pack2 字序全同）；out 尾段（配对与标量分支乘积顺序相同，fused 尾段注释记 identical to w11v8 tail 且同为 1/1024 故共用本条，v1 的 1/128 诚实留待定稿后补链接）；图重放（key[48] 填 41 项余位补零、64 次未命中上限、私有侧流录制、重放在当前流重新执行读当前内存故原地写回与副作用照常、与自复位标志及标志指针入键的联动）；组合（conv_vec 与 vec 取自不同张量故独立，融合被门限绑死）。源码选择条件、设计成立条件与实验覆盖分别引用各自证据，精确参数与 when 以 YAML 为准。

conclusions.subject: writing_plan
conclusions.text: plan 原样回传 plan_draft，恰好覆盖两份已选非 root（fused_single_launch、warp_row_reduction），wait_for 均为空，我独立认可这一安排：两者的 Contract 全部解析到已定稿的 root.yaml v2，唯一预期的整区引用（fused 的 Math_reshape from root，来源依据是 gdn_fk_kernel 头部“Numerics: identical operations to conv3 + w11v8 ... bit-exact”与尾段“identical to w11v8 tail”）也只指向已存在的 root，两份之间没有引用或先后依赖，因此并行派发不相互等待、无自依赖与循环，也不依赖尚未形成的定义；本次回执补正未改动任何产物，实例登记与等待关系与上轮批准时相同。每份未来代表足以让新作者定位实际实例并理解实质差异：fused 给出 use_fk 分支的单次提交（gridDim=convTotal+hv*n、blockDim 256、attrs=nullptr/numAttrs=0）、按线性 blockIdx.x 划分角色（conv 块 ID 更小、gdn 块 gid→j=gid%hv、i=gid/hv）、threadfence+到达计数且任何退出路径都递增、conv 无关工作提前、tid0 有限自旋与离开计数自复位、.cg/L2 一致性要求，以及“按单请求计数等待充分（conv 工作按请求局部）+ 线性 ID 派发为 de facto”的无死锁依据；warp_row_reduction 给出四路选择中的 gdn_v1_kernel<true|false> 实例、16 行×4 列归属、128 宽 smem、每行整 warp 蝶形归约、更新后直接读出、b1+b2 冗余重算与两次 barrier、尾段 1/128，以及来源记录的性能依据（29.4/27.0us 对 53.5/45.1us）。保留理由分别落在提交与协作、块内归属与归约两条不同主轴，均非 root 加参数可得；预计本地/共享区域、待落实位置（各自 when 与对象命名、v1 定稿后回目录补 uint2↔标量参数记录并落实记录 (c) 的并列链接）均写清且明确不冻结 P5 写法。剩余未知只缺正文命名与展开，无需定向补查，也不构成阻塞。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: P2 识别的机制与档位全部有去处、无遗留未判定的轴，本次修正只把路由信息在完整设计表内也改正确：gdn 四档 → vec==3 由 root 本地定义、vec==2 由记录 (b) 作为 root 的参数、vec==1/0 由 warp_row_reduction 承担（其自身 uint2↔标量两档留作该节点定稿后的参数记录）；conv 两档 → conv3 由 root/fused 承担、标量 conv 由记录 (a)；两种段间交接 → root 的 PDL 与 fused 的设备侧到达/离开计数；提交方式 → 记录 (d) 的直接提交对单槽图重放（三基线共用、差额只写一次）；out 尾段 stride 分支 → 记录 (c)；conv×gdn 组合 → 记录 (e) 且明确不按 2×4 配对建节点、融合被门限绑死。三份 when 加五条记录的并集覆盖 Contract 有效域且无缺口：root 为 vec==3 && conv_vec && ceil_div(channels,512)*request_count>160，fused 为同前两条件且 <=160（与 host 的 fk_flags 分配门限一致），warp_row_reduction 为 vec==1/0 的两种 conv 档，vec==2 与标量 conv 由记录补齐。可达性我按 input.py 与 shape_range.json 独立重算：state.stride(0)=hv*16384+state_slot_padding、conv.stride(0)=channels*(width+2)+conv_slot_padding、两个 padding 允许 0..65536、guarded backing 使数据起点偏移 32 字节，故 padding 取 32/4096/65536（均为 16 的倍数）时全部 vec==3+conv_vec，取 8/4/1 时分别落 vec==2/1/0，奇数 conv_slot_padding 使 conv_vec 不成立——低对齐档与标量 conv 在任务有效域内可达但未被 10 个固定用例覆盖，目录如实标注。测量边界如实：ncu/0.csv 与 ncu/5.csv 每次捕获只有 gdn_fk_kernel（case 0 的 544=20*8+48*8，与 tp=1、head_ratio 默认 3→h=16、hv=48、channels=10240 吻合），其余 8 例为 conv3_kernel（case 1 网格 16×32）+ gdn_w11v8_kernel<(bool)1>（网格 32×32，与 channels=8192、hv=32、n=32 吻合），我对 performance 全树检索 gdn_w11_kernel/gdn_v1_kernel/conv_kernel 零匹配；CERTIFIED_BEST 的 fixed/domain 只有整体时延；SELECTION 的 entry 与 candidate sha 确认被认证实现即本固定源码。来源限制（门限 160 ≈ 0.55×296 常驻、线性 ID 派发 de facto、标志缓冲全零前提、.cg 的 L2 一致点、3.1e-4 快速 sigmoid 声称、外部验收器缺失、两个从不启动的模板实例）保留在范围段并交 P5 按来源事实记录为设计条件，未升格为硬件保证，也未据源码分支推断未测组合性能。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: 无需历史上下文即可理解：范围段自足地交代收录边界（设备侧设计、host 只做校验与几何推导、不含生产 baseline）、三条 host 判定轴、固定用例覆盖与实测归属、有效域内的工作与副作用、待核实与来源限制；完整设计表三行各自给出具体机制、保留理由与关系，root 链接指向实际存在的 root.yaml，两份未来文件按规则标“仅计划”；五条记录均含基线/差异与联动/条件与依据三信息项，基线以 step、role、存储、动作与 rewrite 名称定位，我逐项核对这些名称在 root.yaml 中确实存在且语义相符。修正后的档位标签使“root 承担哪一档”在表内即可正确读出，不再需跳到记录 (b) 或源码才能消歧；未来代表所需的实例定位、实质差异、预计区域与待落实位置齐备，新作者可直接开工。本轮无新增缺项。

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: 分层正确：三条 host 判定（vec/conv_vec/融合门限）与图重放、out 尾段 stride 分支被明确定性为配置选择留在目录，每份完整设计固定一档，root.yaml 中不留开关、枚举或选路；当前方案随输入产生的尺寸与空工作（len=0 无行、非活跃写零、空 conv 块仍授予 launch permission、条件检查点、len>8 防御回退）留在设计侧核对而未移入目录当唯一依据。目录不覆盖 YAML：五条记录都只表达差额与联动，记录 (b) 明写“root.yaml 本身不改”，root 行声明精确参数与 when 以 YAML 为准；未来文件未提前创建，两份仅计划节点只获计划认可，拟共享（fused 的 Math_reshape）明确写成预计而非已证明相同。Contract 未被实现限制收窄：TORCH_CHECK、对齐档位、len<=8 活跃门与两个从不启动的模板实例均未升格为算法前提，死代码与防御路径只在范围段记一次；任务要求范围（shape_range/metadata）与目录收录范围分别说明。REALIZATION 不继承这一点已写入交接（复用 root 区域的 P5 节点须自查 23488B smem + 每线程 32 个预载字 + 64 个 carried FP32 的常驻预算，__launch_bounds__(256,2) 在 root 是 Require）。

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: 全文一致，上轮矛盾已消除。档位表述现在四处统一：第 9 行把 vec 定义为 4/8/16 元素对齐档、第 23/27 行把 root 记为 vec==3（16 元素整除 + 32B 基址）、第 42-43 行记录 (b) 把 8 元素整除 + 16B 基址归 vec==2 并声明 vec==3 走 root、第 60 行组合记录按同一档位路由；这与源码 a8(&15u)→vec==2、a16(&31u)→vec==3、w11v8 的“32B alignment guaranteed by the a16 gate”以及 kernel 选择注释的“16B-aligned strides 属 vec==2 的 W11”一致，也与 root.yaml 的 when 和 Prefer 理由句一致。其余数字与事实我重新核对仍全部对上：门限 160 与 2 块/SM×148 SM≈296 的 ~0.55 倍关系、ab3/ab7/ab9 出处、29.4/27.0us 对 53.5/45.1us、key[48] 与 41 项实填、64 次未命中上限、1/1024（root 与 fused）对 1/128（v1）、配对分支的 idx2/sq/m 与标量分支的 idx/sq/m、convTotal 160 与 128、shape 0 的 channels=10240（tp=1、head_ratio 默认 3）、fused 的 grid=convTotal+hv*n 与 i*hv+j 排列、标志自复位的 hv-1 判定、.cg 只用于 mixed。同一决定只记一次（图重放差额三基线共用、vec==1/0 访问宽度归该节点自身参数而不重复记入 root 侧）；未提交/无工作/已执行动作分别贯通（图捕获不执行设备工作、len=0 无行、非活跃有写零事件、空 conv 块仍递增计数）。root.yaml 与上轮逐行审过的版本机械同一，本轮目录变更未与 YAML 产生新张力。

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: 内容必要、无过程残留：dispatch.md 不含退修记录、历史批准、重复决定或实验编号堆砌（源码注释中的 A/B geomean、NCU 计数、job id 未转录进 YAML，目录只在必要处引用来源声称）；“待核实与来源限制”段属正式范围中的研究取舍与来源缺口（门限依据、快速 sigmoid 误差声称、外部验收器缺失、死代码判定），不是可删的过程状态；测量覆盖与未测组合的诚实声明防止后续据分支推断性能。上轮修订只增补必要的消歧信息（档位括注与指向记录 (b)），未引入冗余段落，也未把审阅反馈本身写进产物当作额外语义；本轮为回执补正，产物未再变动。命名清楚常见且多源自源码（vec/conv_vec/融合门限/L(8)/折叠读出/到达-离开计数），worker 并在交接中留下“档位措辞统一用 N 元素整除 + 基址字节数或径写 vec 值”的约定，有助于两份新节点不再复用歧义简写。root.yaml 保留必要数学、精度路径、动作契约与设计理由，无实验数据或性能结论混入；P3 交下的可选整理项（Math 中三处理由/等价句、invk 的重复说明、store:history_shift 声明为 serial 比源码所需更严）不改变含义且 root.yaml 在 P4 只读，已原样留在交接中交 P6 集中处理。
